title: Acquisition of One 6-Pax Executive Van
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US EMBASSY TOKYO
detail_text: Please note that this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The U.S. Embassy Tokyo will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The U.S. Embassy Tokyo requires a Contractor to furnish and deliver one 6-pax executive van for the Law Enforcement Attaché Office in Tokyo (LEGATT) of the U.S. Embassy Tokyo, Japan. All responsible sources may submit a quote, which will be considered.
